_comment: Tunable Lead Scoring parameters (P3). final = clamp( (w.opportunity*opp + w.demand*demand + w.readiness*readiness + w.decision_maker*dm) * region_mult * prospect_mult * tier_mult, 0, 100 ). Each subscore is 0-100. Edit and re-run `python -m lead_scoring.run` to re-score. UNKNOWN multipliers are intentionally near-neutral (0.9) so unclassified stub companies are not unfairly crushed. coverage_normalization (0..1) divides the weighted base by the weight of the signals that actually had data, so a strong company with missing signals is not diluted by the absent zeros (1 = full normalization, 0 = legacy weighted average). confidence_bands map the count of present engine signals (opportunity/demand/decision-makers, 0-3) to low/medium/high confidence.

review_feedback._comment: Optional human-review -> score adjustment (reconciled Change_05). enabled=false keeps the model score untouched and adjusted==model everywhere (Task viii default). When true, a SEPARATE adjusted score/grade is derived per company from its current lead_reviews.review_status: boost multiplies the model score, penalty multiplies down, floor_grade lifts to a minimum grade. The model lead_score/grade are NEVER modified; the adjustment never compounds (always from the pristine model score). Score-affecting statuses then require a reason + manager/admin.
